name: academic-peer-review
description: Multi-reviewer academic peer review panel (Alfa, Beta, Gamma, Delta) with 3-axis classification (5 areas × 15 article types × 12 research approaches), statcheck p-value recalculation, OpenAlex citation/retraction audit, target-journal scope check, FAIR data integrity, prompt-injection defense, and PDF report synthesis. Output is an AI-assisted draft for human referees.

author.name: Prof. Dr. Fabiano Bezerra Menegidio (LaBiOmicS / UMC)
